generations.notes: 75.3 kWh pack (one table says 75.2 kWh) for both FWD and AWD at the 2023 reveal; no confirmed North American DC peak found. The LFP 70.8 kWh VF 7 is an Indian-market version, not this car. EPA MY2025 and 2027, NRCan MY2025. Confidence: low (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/630165/vinfast-releases-vf-6-and-vf-7-specifications-at-ces-2023/ ; https://vinfastauto.us/vehicles/vf-7
